name: framework-comparison
objective: Compare the current PydanticAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen approaches to multi-agent research workflows. Focus on orchestration model, persistence, tool use, evaluation, and operational complexity. Prefer official documentation.

name: technical-claim-audit
objective: Determine whether PostgreSQL advisory locks are appropriate for preventing duplicate execution of the same background job across multiple workers. Explain limitations and identify safer alternatives for long-running work. Prefer PostgreSQL primary documentation.

name: model-research
objective: Compare two current frontier language models for evidence-heavy web research. Separate model capability from search harness effects and prefer primary model/provider documentation plus independent benchmarks.
